memory_candidates.content: Adopting Mathlib's standard linter set under CI --wfail: enable the set in a package-level [leanOptions] table plus a temporary weak.linter.X = false per non-clean class, deleting each line when its class reaches zero. unusedFintypeInType/unusedDecidableInType read only the statement: fix with [Finite X] or by dropping the binder, or `omit [..] in` for section variables, adding haveI := Fintype.ofFinite X / Classical.decEq X only where the proof then fails. Afterwards run `lake exe runLinter` (unusedArguments): definitions built from those theorems can lose their use of the instance, which cascades back into theorem statements.

#count_heartbeats in reports only the header cost unless `set_option Elab.async false` is in effect (Lean 4.33), because proofs elaborate asynchronously. Mathlib's maxHeartbeats linter wants the reason as a `--` comment AFTER `set_option maxHeartbeats N in`; a comment above the option or a docstring does not count.
